name: FEW HICCUPPS
when_to_use: Recognize problems when there is no spec, or the spec is thin, by checking consistency with known or plausible expectations.

letters.description: Familiarity — does the system match a pattern of familiar problems?
Explainability — can the behavior be explained clearly to ourselves and others?
World — is it consistent with what we know about the world?
History — is it consistent with past versions of itself?
Image — does it fit the image/brand the organization wants to project?
Comparable products — is it consistent with comparable products or processes?
Claims — is it consistent with what important people say it should do (docs, specs, meetings)?
User Desires — is it consistent with what reasonable users would want?
Product — is each element consistent with comparable elements in the same product?
Purpose — is it consistent with its explicit and implicit purposes?
Statutes & Standards — is it consistent with relevant laws, regulations, and standards?

example: New version changed behavior with no stated reason → History oracle flags a likely problem.
